name: NXE1S0505MC-R13
title: NXE1 series: 1 W isolated single-output surface-mount DC-DC converters
summary: The NXE1 family are 1 W DC-DC converters on a surface-mount iLGA module, 12.70 by 10.41 mm and 4.36 mm tall, whose transformer is built into the FR4 substrate. Three types exist: 3.3 V in to 3.3 V out (NXE1S0303MC, 303 mA), 3.3 V in to 5 V out (NXE1S0305MC) and 5 V in to 5 V out (NXE1S0505MC), each 200 mA in the 5 V output case. Input and output are separated by a barrier tested at 3 kVDC, recognised to UL62368-1 and ANSI/AAMI ES60601-1. They run from -40 to 85 °C in free air, are halogen free, MSL 2, and have short circuit protection.

notes: The name reads NXE, 1 for the power rating in watts, S for a single output (D would be dual), two digits of input voltage, two digits of output voltage, M for surface mount (S, D and Z code SIP, DIP and ZIP), C for RoHS compliance, then -R7 or -R13 for a 7 inch or 13 inch reel.
Every orderable part comes on tape and reel.

circuits.title: Differential mode ripple and noise test
circuits.description: Bench set-up for the ripple and noise figures. A supply feeds the converter input, whose negative side is earthed. RLOAD draws rated power from the output through twisted wires. C1, C2 and C3 sit across the output; C3 passes the ripple to R1, which feeds the coax centre conductor. The coax runs three turns through a ferrite toroid (T1) to the scope's Y input, with R2 across it at the scope end; its shield joins the output return to the earthed scope ground.

operation.text: The output voltage moves with load. The tolerance envelopes give the worst-case output spread from set-point error and load. For the NXE1S0303MC the output lies between +5.5 % and -1.5 % of nominal at 10 % load and between -5.4 % and -13.4 % at full load; for the NXE1S0305MC between +9.2 % and +3.9 % at 10 % load and between +0.3 % and -5.8 % at full load; for the NXE1S0505MC between +10 % and +3 % at 10 % load and between +4.5 % and -3.5 % at full load. Line regulation is 1.1 %/% typ.
The figures hold from 10 % of rated load upward over the whole input range. Below 10 % the output rises, and with less than 5 % load it can reach about twice its nominal value.
Output short circuit protection is continuous at nominal input and low ambient temperatures. At 65 °C ambient and above, how long a short can be sustained is limited.

With 10 µF on the output and an input rising in 2.2 µs, start-up takes 150 µs (NXE1S0303MC), 400 µs (NXE1S0305MC) or 250 µs (NXE1S0505MC) typ. The largest recommended output capacitance is 10 µF; the converters still start into 47 µF, more slowly.

The NXE1S0303MC and NXE1S0305MC deliver 1.0 W from -40 °C to 85 °C ambient. The NXE1S0505MC, on a 1 inch veroboard, carries full load to 85 °C at 5.5 V in, 95 °C at 5 V in and 100 °C at 4.5 V in; its load limit then falls to zero at 95 °C, 100 °C and 105 °C respectively, with a step from 50 % to zero at 100 °C on 5 V in. The case runs about 22 °C above ambient. Cooling is free-air convection.

The transformer is embedded in the PCB substrate, with FR4 insulating primary from secondary. Each part is hi-pot tested at 3 kVDC for 1 s in production, and the design was qualified at 3 kVDC for 1 minute. Repeated hi-pot testing wears the FR4 barrier down; if a retest cannot be avoided, use a voltage 20 % below the rated test voltage. Continuous working voltage is 125 Vrms for reinforced and 250 Vrms for basic insulation under UL62368-1, and 250 Vrms for 1 MOOP under ANSI/AAMI ES60601-1.
The module is not hermetic; it should be dry before input power is applied.
With the input filter capacitor and inductor in the EMC filter table added, conducted emission meets EN 55022 Curve B quasi-peak limits.

The recommended footprint marks an isolation barrier zone between the input-side lands and the output-side lands. Pad 14 takes no electrical connection. The placement pickup point is on the top of the PCB, 3.11 mm above the seating plane and 7.62 mm (reference) from one end of the body.
